stable_traits.physical_traits: taller than most men, broad in the shoulders, dark reddish hair, gray eyes
stable_traits.age: youth barely old enough to be called a man
stable_traits.filiations: Tam al'Thor (father, though questioned internally by Rand)
stable_traits.personality: internally conflicted about his identity and destiny, frightened of his power yet drawn to understanding it

characters.notes: Protagonist. Struggles with his identity and the heron-marked sword Tam gave him. Learning swordsmanship from Lan. Terrified of the Amyrlin Seat's arrival, believing she has come 'because of me' - likely connected to his ability to channel.

stable_traits.physical_traits: just as tall as Rand, more heavily muscled, long hair held back by braided leather, face of stony planes and angles, unlined face but with gray at temples, icy blue eyes
stable_traits.age: mature adult, implied middle-aged by gray temples
stable_traits.filiations: al'Lan Mandragoran, Lord of the Seven Towers, Lord of the Lakes, uncrowned King of Malkier; bonded to Moiraine
stable_traits.personality: stoic, controlled, shows little emotion even for a Warder, protective of Moiraine above all else

characters.notes: Training Rand in swordsmanship. His sword is one of the Aes Sedai-made blades from the War of the Shadow. Bonded Warder to Moiraine.

stable_traits.personality: enigmatic, deliberately distant from Rand after telling him 'horrible things about himself'

characters.notes: Has recently returned from being away. Rand is desperate for her help but afraid she won't provide it. She told Rand 'horrible things about himself' and now avoids speaking with him.
Still in Fal Dara with Rand and Perrin. Thinks Rand is 'crazy not to go home' with them.
Still in Fal Dara with Rand and Mat. Thinks Rand is 'crazy not to go home' with them.

stable_traits.personality: fearless, but now uncertain around Rand

characters.notes: Her behavior toward Rand has changed - alternating between maternal concern and treating him like a stranger she might offend by looking too closely.

stable_traits.filiations: romantic interest of Rand's from home; going to become an Aes Sedai
stable_traits.personality: determined to become an Aes Sedai; stubborn when Rand tries to tell her what to do

characters.notes: Planning to go to Tar Valon to become an Aes Sedai. Rand wishes she would go with him instead, but knows he can't ask her to give up that destiny. She 'gets muley stubborn' if he tries to tell her what to do.

stable_traits.filiations: Rand's father (though Rand's internal monologue suggests questions about this)

characters.notes: Gave Rand the heron-marked sword. Rand insists internally that Tam is his father 'no matter what anybody says.' The sword may have knowledge/history Tam didn't share with Rand.
Returning from 'hunting' with the Aes Sedai column. Lan wonders if he had any luck.

factions.name: White Tower
factions.notes: Supreme authority over all Aes Sedai

characters.notes: Traveling in the palanquin. Rand is terrified she has come 'because of me' - either to gentle him or to help him (he's not sure which frightens him more).
Mentioned in Rand's internal monologue about the things he's experienced - he has met her.

appearances.whereabouts: atop a tower in Fal Dara fortress, then fleeing down when the Amyrlin Seat's party arrives
appearances.notable_actions: Practicing swordsmanship with Lan. Experiences a strange wind that feels solid and pushes him forward into Lan's blade, causing injury. Struggles with his identity and fear of Aes Sedai. Watches the Amyrlin Seat's procession arrive with mounting terror. Flees when he realizes she has entered the city gates.
appearances.demeanor: anxious, conflicted, terrified, defensive about his identity and destiny

appearances.whereabouts: atop a tower in Fal Dara fortress training Rand
appearances.notable_actions: Teaching Rand swordsmanship. Explains the history of Aes Sedai-made blades and reveals Rand's sword is one of them. Observes the arriving procession and identifies the Amyrlin Seat. Tells Rand his lessons are done and that it would be 'better for you if you were a week gone.'
appearances.demeanor: controlled, stoic, but shows brief moments of what might be sympathy for Rand's situation; becomes brisk when discussing sword forms

appearances.whereabouts: returned to Fal Dara the previous night after being away; current location unspecified
appearances.notable_actions: Has returned from somewhere but is not present in this scene. Previously told Rand 'horrible things about himself' and now avoids speaking with him.

appearances.whereabouts: in Fal Dara (not in this scene)
appearances.notable_actions: Mentioned as still being in Fal Dara with Rand and Perrin; thinks Rand is crazy not to go home.

appearances.whereabouts: in Fal Dara (not in this scene)
appearances.notable_actions: Mentioned as still being in Fal Dara with Rand and Mat; thinks Rand is crazy not to go home.

appearances.whereabouts: in Fal Dara (not in this scene)
appearances.notable_actions: Mentioned as behaving strangely toward Rand - alternating between maternal concern and treating him like a stranger.
appearances.demeanor: uncertain, conflicted in how she interacts with Rand

appearances.whereabouts: in Fal Dara, planning to go to Tar Valon (not in this scene)
appearances.notable_actions: Mentioned as knowing why Rand has to leave but looking at him in a way that makes him 'knot up inside' whenever he mentions it. Planning to become an Aes Sedai.
appearances.demeanor: conflicted about Rand's departure; determined about her own path

appearances.whereabouts: presumably back in the Two Rivers (not present)
appearances.notable_actions: Mentioned as having given Rand the heron-marked sword; may or may not know its true origin as Aes Sedai work.

appearances.whereabouts: returning to Fal Dara with the Amyrlin Seat's procession
appearances.notable_actions: Returning from 'hunting' with the Aes Sedai party. Lan observes he's been gone long enough and wonders if he had luck.

appearances.whereabouts: traveling in a palanquin at the head of a procession entering Fal Dara
appearances.notable_actions: Arriving at Fal Dara with drums, trumpets, a banner bearing the Flame of Tar Valon, and many Aes Sedai. Her arrival terrifies Rand, who believes she has come because of him.
appearances.demeanor: formal, ceremonial arrival with great pomp

appearances.notable_actions: Mentioned in Rand's thoughts about the worldly experiences he's had.

relationships.description: Moiraine holds Lan's Warder bond. Lan values her life and safety above his own.
Lan is teaching Rand swordsmanship and survival skills. Shows what might be sympathy for Rand's situation.
Tam raised Rand and gave him the heron-marked sword. Rand insists Tam is his father despite hints that his parentage might be more complicated.
Rand has romantic feelings for Egwene and wishes she would go with him instead of to Tar Valon, but knows he cannot ask her to give up becoming an Aes Sedai.
Friends from the Two Rivers. Rand doesn't want to leave before Mat does.
Friends from the Two Rivers. Rand doesn't want to leave before Perrin does.

Complex relationship - Moiraine saved Rand's life and told him things about himself that terrify him. Now she avoids him. He desperately wants her help but fears what she might do (gentle him or leave him to go mad).
